notes.title: Beta-Branch v1.3
notes.notes:
After collecting some feedback recently, we have integrated a few Quality of Life features, integrated sound and graphic effects, fixed a few minor bugs and are preparing another major update.

To summarize:
[list]
[*] new sound effects
[*] Particle effects during collection
[*] new accident animation
[*] completed levels are now graphically highlighted
[*] Hotkeys for selecting arrows, parking areas etc. can be set by yourself
[*] bug fixes and more
[/list]

As briefly mentioned above, there will be a major update, as we have been told that it would be nicer if you could create levels yourself and share them with friends. Unfortunately, this requires a few adjustments to the level system. Therefore, we will need some time and also have to think about how we can support the sharing of levels for you in a meaningful way.

But until we are ready, we would like to make all the QoL features available to you in advance with the Beta-Branch v1.3. If we don't find any major bugs in the coming weeks, we will release the status of the Beta-Branch in the normal branch. 

If you have any further suggestions or requests, please feel free to contact us at any time. 


https://twitch.tv/mrmiepo

https://discord.gg/qNp4uaKQmX

notes.title: Beta-Branch of the new Pathfinder Puzzle
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

first I have to say sorry for not being seen for a long time, but there was a lot of work and big changes, that has to be done. After a lot of research and testing I decided to switch from Unity to Godot and then there was a Godot update, which effected, that I had to rewrite a lot of code.

Now that is all done, and I recreated the game with a totally new outfit, new features and achievements. 
All that is now published within some few tutorial levels in the [b]beta-branch[/b]. You can download and test it. In the future you have to manage multiple cars in one level, placing parking areas and could play a lot of new levels. 

I will start tomorrow with integrating the old levels into the new system and when this all is done, it will be updated into the main-branch. 

Afterward there will be different smaller updates with new levels and achievements. 

Thank you all for the whole support and feedback here and on [url=https://twitch.tv/mrmiepo]Twitch[/url] where I sometime be live working on this and other games.

Yours MrMiepo

notes.title: Next generation Pathfinder Puzzle
notes.notes:
Hello users and fans, 

after working on a several new prototypes I started now to integrate some new technics in pathfinder puzzle to get the game to a new look and feel. I will try to get a big update in the months working. I'm not sure if it will be possible to use old save games than, but if not you can be sure, that you will have a nearly "new game" to discover. 

With the new system I have a lot more and better options to build levels and add different game modes for you. So I hope you'll be as interested in this than I'm at the moment.
